title: Define summary discovery-negation behavior when a third-party subject is elided
outcome: Resolve or document the diagnostic ambiguity when a negated discovery clause omits a third-party subject after punctuation, preserving default-visible severity and reviewer authority boundaries. This is an optional Low follow-up; it does not block the parent's Medium repairs.
acceptance: Packet-level controls compare explicit reviewer negation, explicit third-party missed discovery, and a punctuated continuation with an elided subject; the intended visibility policy is documented.
Any implementation change preserves default-visible real severities, highest-severity diagnostics, empty structured findings for Findings None, and unchanged AsBefore recovery.
